case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
Here is the background.
Thank you for your proposal and the prospect of a 36-month contract.
While we value the planning security, a 90-day payment term is not feasible for us, and we must maintain our standard 30 days net.
Based on the 36-month term, we can offer a slight adjustment to €4.94 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €4.88 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised proposal. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We always strive to deliver the best value and support for your operations. However, we cannot accommodate a further price reduction for the 90-day payment term. 

Our offer of a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months remains our best possible pricing for a 36-month contract under these terms. We appreciate your partnership and remain committed to supporting your business with our reliable service and extensive product inventory. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised proposal. We always appreciate the opportunity to work closely with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to support your business with our extensive inventory and dedicated service. 

As previously stated, we cannot accommodate a further price reduction for the 90-day payment term. Our pricing directly reflects our main cost drivers, which are PPI-C2815 and LCI-C. Consequently, a price of €4.94 per unit represents our final offer (letztes Angebot) for a contract term of 36 months under these conditions, paired with a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net. 

This is our final offer, so please decide if you would like to proceed. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days. We hope to continue our partnership and look forward to hearing your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
